title: Represent Rational Numbers and Their Opposites on the Number Line

items.stem: Which point on the number line represents the opposite of 3/4?
A submarine is located at -150 feet below sea level. What is the opposite of this position on the number line?
Select ALL statements that are true about rational numbers and their opposites on the number line.
choices: Opposite numbers are the same distance from zero but on different sides of the number line.
The opposite of a positive rational number is always negative.
Opposite numbers always add up to 1.

items.stem: Plot the rational numbers -2/3, 1/2, and their opposites on a number line. Then explain how you determined the location of each number and its opposite. Show or explain your work.
